g.text: Visual Prototyping Layout (Half-Size 400-Point Breadboard + Arduino UNO R3 + Optoisolated Relay)
Inserted directly into crop soil (Corrosion-resistant probe with no exposed conductive copper).
🔴 VCC Wire: Connects to Breadboard Row 14 → Red (+) Rail (5V)
🔵 GND Wire: Connects to Breadboard Row 15 → Blue (-) Rail (GND)
🟢 AOUT Wire: Connects to Breadboard Row 16 → Arduino Analog A0
✓ Calibrated ADC range: 310 (100% saturation) to 720 (dry air)
✓ Watchdog safeguard: Automated shutoff after 180s continuous pumping
